title: Unfound-Line Room and Refund — Finance Calculation Note for Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
# Unfound-line room and refund

**Finance calculation note, Cartwise Grocery Orders.** A line billed although the shopper recorded its product as not found is refunded within a room tied to the order's size. The quantities are defined as follows.

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Unfound-line charge | The sum of the amounts billed on the line recorded as not found, less any missing refund already standing on the order, never below zero |
| Unfound-line cap basis | The order's item subtotal, the sum of its billed item lines |
| Unfound-line cap share | The self-service refund cap percentage of the order's service level |
| Unfound-line room | The lower of the service level's self-service refund cap in dollars and the cap share of the cap basis (rounded to the cent), less the item refunds already granted on the order for missing, damaged, wrong item and quality issues, and never below zero |
| Unfound-line refund | The lower of the unfound-line charge and the unfound-line room, rounded to the cent |

The self-service refund cap in dollars and the self-service refund cap percentage are the figures of the order's own service level. "Item refunds already granted" counts every item refund entry on the order whose reason is missing, damaged, wrong item or quality; refunds for other reasons do not enter it.

## Order of working

The cap share is applied to the cap basis and rounded to the cent; the lower of that figure and the dollar cap is taken; the refunds already granted are taken off that lower figure, with zero as the floor. The refund is then the lower of this room and the unfound-line charge.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Suppose a service level whose dollar cap were 60.00 and whose cap percentage were 50 percent, and an order with billed item lines totalling 84.37, on which one line billed 9.98 is recorded as not found. A damaged refund of 17.50 already stands on the order; no missing refund stands.

- Unfound-line charge: 9.98 less nothing, that is 9.98.
- Cap share of the cap basis: 84.37 at 50 percent is 42.185, rounded to 42.19.
- Lower of 60.00 and 42.19: 42.19.
- Room: 42.19 less 17.50, that is 24.69.
- **Refund: the lower of 9.98 and 24.69, that is 9.98.**

Had the refunds already granted come to 38.00 instead, the room would be 42.19 less 38.00, that is 4.19, and the refund would be **4.19**; the remaining 5.79 of the charge is not booked by this refund. Had they come to 45.00, the room would floor at zero.
